subject: Mid-term renewal: temporary safety window + pool resize and throughput guarantee
messages:
From: Kiran Menon <kiran@clearsight.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearsight.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal + short-term capacity spike / throughput commitment

Hi Grace / Aditya,

We're reviewing our Dedicated pool with Redwood ahead of the July renewal. Two asks from engineering and procurement:

1) We need to add capacity quickly for a clinical pilot — estimate ~8 additional A100-equivalent GPUs for a 10-week period starting July 1.
2) Our product team needs a documented throughput guarantee for our main endpoint (p95 token-latency target) during the pilot window; failing that, we need a partial SLA credit.

Procurement also flagged pricing: they want a short-term, mid-contract add-on price rather than a full 12-month commit. Can you propose a packaging that lets us burst without doubling our committed spend?

I've attached the pilot SOW and a short perf report. Looking for a proposal by EOD Monday so we can loop in finance.

Thanks,
Kiran
ClearSight Health

Attachments: ClearSight_SOW_v2.pdf, throughput_benchmark_q2.csv

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Menon <kiran@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal + short-term capacity spike / throughput commitment

Kiran — thanks for the details and attachments. High level: we can support a temporary pool expansion + a short "safety window" that gives you headroom without forcing a 12-month commit. A couple quick clarifying q's before we price:

- Is the 8-GPU need continuous or bursty over the 10 weeks? (engineering says steady for the pilot)
- Do you need a hard p95 token-latency or p99? Your note says p95 but procurement is asking about SLA credits.

I'll draft options (safety window, pro-rata reserved addendum, and an on-demand burst fallback) and loop in Aditya for pricing by Monday.

—Grace
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: FW: Renewal + short-term capacity spike / throughput commitment — pricing sketch

Team — sketching pricing and packaging for ClearSight pilot. Notes below (numbers are internal sketches until we align on concessions):

Option A — Temporary safety window (recommended):
- Add 8 GPUs to existing Dedicated pool for 10 weeks starting 2027-07-01
- Billing: pro-rata monthly on a reserved-rate equivalent but with safety-window discount: 40% of reserved unit rate (reflects shorter term & administrative overhead)
- Throughput guarantee: documented p95 token-latency target of <= 350ms at their current workload profile; 2% monthly credit for breaches (capped)
- No 12-month lock required; after 10 weeks capacity falls back automatically.
- Expected list price delta: ~$52,000 total for the 10-week window (billing mechanics: bill July pro-rata + August full month + Sept pro-rata depending on dates)

Option B — Short-term reserved addendum:
- 3-month commit for 8 GPUs at 70% of standard reserved rate (requires an amendment). Better unit economics but requires contract change.

Option C — On-demand burst fallback:
- Let them burst on-demand with higher unit price (120% of on-demand) and Redwood guarantees scaling but no latency SLA for bursts. Cheap to implement but higher risk for their perf requirements.

Concession playbook (if Procurement pushes):
- Offer a 10% one-time onboarding credit if they sign the addendum now.
- Trade: 6% discount on renewal if they convert the safety window to a 12-month uplift within 90 days.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-quote-2027-06-06.xlsx (internal).

Lauren — can you sanity-check the SLA credit language and approval on the 40% safety-window rate? Jonas — FYI on impact to our pool headroom and preemption behavior.

- Aditya

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FW: Renewal + short-term capacity spike / throughput commitment — pricing sketch

Appreciate the clear options. A few edits from a risk + legal perspective before customer-facing: 

- Change SLA credit wording: replace open % with a fixed credit table (e.g., p95 miss = 2% credit; p99 miss = 4% credit; max aggregate for window = 10%). Keeps finance comfortable.
- Approve safety-window at 40% of reserved-unit for fixed 10-week term; assume no additional support retainer.
- Require a short addendum that defines: expected RPS profile, test harness (we'll accept their benchmark CSV), and an escape clause if production profile exceeds agreed curve (to allow throttling or rollback).

If Procurement presses, we can offer the 10% onboarding credit tied to an opt-in for a 12-month uplift conversion within 90 days.

Please turn this into a customer-facing email and include the redwood quote.

—Lauren

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Menon <kiran@clearsight.ai>, Procurement <procurement@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal + short-term capacity spike / throughput commitment

Kiran — thanks for the SOW and perf CSV. Per internal approvals we can offer the following customer option for the July pilot: 

Customer-facing proposal (summary):
- Safety Window: Add 8 GPUs to your Dedicated pool for a fixed 10-week term starting 2027-07-01.
- Billing: Safety-window pricing at 40% of our reserved unit rate, invoiced pro-rata across the term (estimated total ~$52k).
- Throughput SLA: p95 token-latency <= 350ms for the agreed test harness and RPS curve (we validated your attached CSV). If p95 exceeds 350ms, ClearSight will receive a 2% credit on the monthly Dedicated invoice; p99 misses will trigger a 4% credit. Maximum aggregate credit during the window is 10%.
- Conversion option: Convert the safety window to a 12-month uplift within 90 days of the term start and receive a 10% one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice after conversion.
- Operational notes: We'll provision capacity in your primary region and provide a runbook for test harness ramp. If production load exceeds the agreed curve we reserve the right to throttle or roll back the safety window to protect overall pool SLOs (we'll notify you and offer alternatives).

Attached is the formal quote and a short addendum draft. Let us know if Procurement needs edits; happy to jump on a call Monday afternoon.

Best,
Grace
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-quote-2027-06-06.xlsx, ClearSight_addendum_draft.docx
